tasks.label: build
tasks.detail: Build the project (Debug). Runs before the Debug host launch configurations

tasks.label: TrakHound: Build package
tasks.detail: Build the package file (.thp) with th packages dotnet

tasks.label: TrakHound: Publish package
tasks.detail: Build the package and publish it to the defaultTarget in trakhound.package.publish.json

tasks.label: TrakHound: Dev run in Instance
tasks.detail: Install the package in the local Instance (TRAKHOUND_DEV_INSTANCE) and reinstall it on each save. Stop it with Ctrl+C in its terminal

tasks.label: TrakHound: Dev clean
tasks.detail: Remove what Dev run left in the local Instance (TRAKHOUND_DEV_INSTANCE)
